content: Child digital-wellbeing education consensus (AAP, Mayo, Boston Children's, Children & Screens, expert reviews): avoid fear-based/abstinence narratives - the best way to get kids to tune out is scaring them; favor practical strategies, agency and balance; screens have benefits; researchers prefer 'problematic media use' over 'addiction'; targeting narrow age bands (9-12 has distinct needs; scanning readers); structure content as facts-first with actionable tips, not moralizing limits.
